title: Malformed, denied and racing API evidence
summary: Fixed GET endpoints can fail from permissions, protocol mismatch, oversized output, timeouts or container lifetime changes. These collector gaps must not establish healthy workload state.
checks: Repeat a bounded request after confirming the socket and instance ID.
Preserve denied/unknown evidence and separate API availability from application availability.
limitations: Response bodies are discarded; only safe aggregate metadata is retained.
